name: Volunteer Program (Santa Barbara Humane Society)
what_you_do: Volunteer with dogs, cats, the clinic or outreach. You go through a virtual meeting, orientation and role training, then start solo shifts.
who_can_apply: Volunteers 16 and older. Volunteers 15 or younger are welcome with an adult partner. This is a parent or guardian volunteer who goes to training and works next to them.
duration: The page asks for at least 8 to 12 hours a month, and in another place at least two hours a week for 4 to 6 months.
deadline_text: No deadline. The page says the dog and cat volunteer opportunities are currently full.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application for the role you want (dog, cat or clinic) and pick an orientation date and time. Outreach applications go by email. Main phone: 805-964-4777, or use the contact form on the page.
notes: Confirm first: the dog and cat roles were full when checked, and the page gives two different time commitments. Younger volunteers need a parent or guardian to volunteer with them.
